notes.title: Mortanis Prisoners - Release!
notes.notes:
Greetings, players!

We're excited to announce that Mortanis: Prisoners has officially left Early Access and is now available in its full release version!

Thank you to everyone who joined us on this journey — from the earliest alpha builds to the final release. Your feedback, support, and ideas helped shape the game into what it is today.

notes.title: New Patch – Achievements and Updates
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

In the new update, we’ve added achievements, improved the puzzle text, and introduced a skip option for the rotating statues puzzle. We’ve also made many minor fixes.

The game is essentially complete, and those who have been waiting for the release can start playing now. We’ve decided to postpone the official release due to a low number of wishlist additions. For now, we’ll focus on actively promoting the game, potentially looking for a publisher, and preparing the game for a console release.

During this time, we’ll be watching playthroughs on video platforms, continuing to test the game, and polishing any bugs that may arise.

notes.title: Big update and a free prologue!
notes.notes:
A major update ahead of the game's full release, which is coming in the next few weeks.

The update is already available, and you can also help support the free prologue: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469550/Mortanis_Prisoners_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink]

all you need to do is download and launch it. This will help boost traffic on Steam.

The update brings a lot of new content, including an entirely new location.

Bosses, a new enemy type, a map, ghosts, new puzzles, and even more action!

notes.title: Big Update! New content!
notes.notes:
Good day!
This update doubles the size of the game, adding new zones, weapons, puzzles, cutscenes, and enemies. It also fixes numerous bugs.

The next update will also be large and will be the final one. It will include a significant amount of new content to diversify the gameplay and give it a fresh feel. I plan to release the next update no later than spring.

Additionally, the game’s name will be changed to Ashes of Suffering or something similar. Don’t miss the release when the name changes!
